messages:

Subject: [Notice] EastUS3 - staggered control-plane handshake & rolling restarts (Jul 29)

Hi Donna / Horizon ops team,

We’re scheduling a targeted, staggered maintenance in the EastUS3 region on Thu Jul 29 to perform a controlled control-plane handshake and a small driver refresh on a subset of inference hosts. This is a safety-driven operation to improve kernel/driver compatibility across recently onboarded GPU instances and to remove a low-frequency eviction path we observed in Canary.

High-level details:
- Window: Thu Jul 29, 2026 02:00–06:00 UTC (we will only touch small batches; individual tenant impact expected to be minimal).
- What we’ll do: sequenced control-plane handshake, driver rollforward on a subset of hosts, KV-cache preservation validation to minimize warm-up penalty.
- Risk: brief (1–3s) token-generation latency spikes during handoff for active long-running streams; isolated request retries will succeed with automatic fallback.
- Opt-out: customers can request an opt-out for the window if they have a release or live event (reply with "opt-out" and your tenant id).

Prep & mitigations we recommend:
- Ensure ephemeral streaming sessions are idempotent on your side or can be retried.
- If you have long-lived streaming sessions (>=30m), let us know and we’ll schedule your hosts for later waves.
- Monitor the EastUS3 route in Console for per-route latency spikes; we’ll publish live progress.

Attached: eastus3-control-handshake-runbook-v1.pdf (runbook + rollback steps).

We’ll post a short follow-up with the exact host batches and expected ETA before the first wave. If you’d like to escalate or request a non-standard window, reply here and CC your account rep.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole (Customer Ops)
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Jul 29, 2026 at 09:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> We’re scheduling a targeted, staggered maintenance in the EastUS3 region on Thu Jul 29 to perform a controlled control-plane handshake and a small driver refresh on a subset of inference hosts.

A couple of technical clarifications from the infra side:
- Wave size: ~8-12 hosts per wave, ~6 waves planned across the window. We’ll keep queue depth low for active tenants during each wave.
- KV-cache preservation: we will attempt a warm handoff using the golden prefix checkpoints; for tenants with large KV-footprints, there may be a cold-start for a subset of shards (we estimate under 5% of requests see a cold-step).
- Streaming behavior: keep-alive streams may experience a single reconnect attempt; our LB will retry automatically where possible.
- Telemetry: we’ll tag events with maintenance_id=HS-18274 and publish a short JSON event stream to the shared drive link for live monitoring.

If Horizon has a hard SLA window (e.g., Black Friday testing or an in-market promo) please highlight the tenant IDs you care about and we’ll exclude them from the early waves.

Technical contacts while we run: jonas_weber@redwood.ai (infra) and grace_oconnor@redwood.ai (runtime).

-Jonas

Donna — thanks for the quick reply. Short answers below, plus next steps.

1) SLA/credits: if there is a measurable regression attributable to the maintenance path (post-investigation), we will follow our standard SLA remediation process — we’ll open a case, route it to the incident review board, and propose a credit if the incident meets the SLA thresholds. We’ll commit to a post-run health check and, if needed, a targeted follow-up patch.

2) Opt-out/exclusion: confirmed — horizon-prod-01 and horizon-analytics will be excluded from waves 1 and 2. Please confirm if you want full exclusion for the entire window or just early waves.

3) Console observables: watch the per-route latency and the token-generation histograms; we’ll emit a maintenance tag (HS-18274) visible in the trace sampling UI. I’ll post the direct Console link before we start.

Next steps:
- I’ve attached a postmortem checklist template we’ll use in the unlikely event of regression (postmortem-checklist-v2.xlsx).
- If you want complete opt-out for the window, reply with subject line: "Opt-out: HS-18274 - horizon-prod-01, horizon-analytics".
- We’ll publish a live progress thread and a short readout within 90 minutes after the window closes.

If anything changes before the window we’ll update here.

Best,
